title: list 是动态数组：原地扩容，对象身份稳定
expected_output:
[0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
same object after append: True
list 按需 over-allocation 扩容，append 不创建新对象
code:
xs = []
for n in range(5):
    xs.append(n)
print(xs)

a = []
before = id(a)
a.append(1)
print("same object after append:", id(a) == before)
print("list 按需 over-allocation 扩容，append 不创建新对象")
